prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='THETA', seasonality_champion='CWT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: THETA achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) but poor RMSE (4105.56), while CWT_rf leads seasonality capture (0.562) with solid RMSE (206.30). ONLY_CWT_catboost dominates overall RMSE (176.78) with balanced early/late performance. High rmse_spread_ratio (35.63) and seasonality variance (0.718) indicate significant model disagreement, warranting STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit the split between trend champion (THETA) and seasonality champion (CWT_rf) while leveraging ONLY_CWT_catboost's overall accuracy.
